signature.name: VTask.mkContinuousLinear
signature.type: {𝕜 : Type u} -> {ι : Type v} -> {E : ι → Type wE} -> {G : Type wG} -> {G' : Type wG'} -> [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] -> [(i : ι) → SeminormedAddCommGroup (E i)] -> [(i : ι) → NormedSpace 𝕜 (E i)] -> [SeminormedAddCommGroup G] -> [NormedSpace 𝕜 G] -> [SeminormedAddCommGroup G'] -> [NormedSpace 𝕜 G'] -> [Fintype ι] -> (f : G →ₗ[𝕜] MultilinearMap 𝕜 E G') -> (C : ℝ) -> (H : ∀ (x : G) (m : (i : ι) → E i), ‖(f x) m‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ * ∏ i, ‖m i‖) -> G →L[𝕜] ContinuousMultilinearMap 𝕜 E G'

conventions.statement: If C is negative, the construction still succeeds; internally the operator norm of the result is bounded by max C 0 = 0, so in this case the hypothesis H forces f to be identically zero.
conventions.note: The definition does not require C ≥ 0; it accepts any real C and uses max C 0 as the effective bound.
